svg.title: How Agentroid connects an AI agent to an Android phone
svg.desc: Three parts in a row. Your AI agent (Claude Code, on your PC) asks Agentroid to look, tap or type. Agentroid, an MCP server and a small daemon on your PC, checks each action and makes no AI calls of its own, then drives your Android phone over adb, by USB or Wi-Fi. Coming back, the phone's raw screen description is 11,565 tokens; Agentroid hands the AI a short list of 229 tokens.
